content.title: IPL 2026 Points Table After Chennai Super Kings vs Delhi Capitals Match
content.text: IPL 2026 Points Table: In IPL 2026, Chennai Super Kings (CSK) won their first game. They defeated Delhi Capitals by 23 runs at Chepauk. Sanju Samson gave an outstanding performance and scored 115 runs without being dismissed. Ayush Mhatre also contributed with 59 runs. CSK accumulated 212 runs.However, Delhi Capitals attempted to counterattack but managed to accumulate 189 runs. Tristan Stubbs scored 60 runs but couldn’t prevent defeat. Jamie Overton took four wickets to help CSK secure victory.This victory is very significant for CSK because they lost their previous three games. This will increase their confidence. Delhi Capitals have remained at fourth position.
